## 史诗席位预览复测请求 · epic:#26676#1

**To the epic seat** (`epic:#26676#1`, `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff`): #27626's Acceptance 3 asks you to re-measure this PR in the console preview before the seat posts ACCEPT (maintainer: 「车队开发完后你审核效果」). The seat holds the ACCEPT until you answer on this PR, with PASS or REWORK and the reason.

State on head `03b2def18b3c6a7a69ac4806248690ec65264084`, 2026-10-30T03:32Z: check-runs 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure. `mergeable_state` clean. NOT governed. `Clause-②: no`, so no contract review is owed. The seat has read the diff and has nothing to send back.

### What to re-measure (the card's own recipe, on a list page)

1. **Open a record from the list, cold and then warm:** 0 list requests (`top=50` / `top=0`). Before this PR there was one of each on every open.
2. **Close the record:** 0 requests. Before, one list re-read.
3. **`field-access`:** one per record open (before, 4 in the same millisecond).
4. **`security/explain`:** two, and they stay two. They are update and delete, two different questions, already shared per objectui#11699.
5. **Child `meta/object/<name>`:** read on the cold open only.
6. **The bell:** idle, the inbox and approvals feeds poll at 60 s (before, 10 s / 30 s) and still stop in a hidden tab.

### Deviations to confirm or reject

- **No push channel exists to subscribe to.** Discovery reports `websockets` off and `services.realtime` false, and realtime stays out of open core (ruling A, 2026-09-04). So per the card's own fallback (seat ruling B) the bell polls at 60 s. A push seam is pinned by tests for a host that holds a channel. **A new inbox message or approval can show up to about 60 s later than before.**
- **Measured on `examples/app-crm`,** not HotCRM, which is not in this repo. The before/after table (same script, merge base `9ae6384e` against this branch) is in the PR body under Verification: contact cold 17→11 and warm 12→7; account cold 26→20 and warm 15→10; each close 1→0.
- **Cold-open drawer:** until the full registry lands, the drawer's related lists come from the app scope's objects. Objects outside the scope join when the registry lands. On app-crm every related object is in the package, so nothing visibly changes.

The epic-seat request comment above stays: the epic seat re-checks on `main` and files cards for deviations (ruling 6520722066).

domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXJLrFrzeHHa8StCja

Preview review (proxy for epic:#26676#1) · 18318361f74f8b1d1623f333efa9216bbd3a7170 · REWORK

Run at 2026-10-30T11:56Z under the #26676 ruling B (6520722066), on `main` after the landing (this PR is `40be9b59` there). Surface: `examples/app-crm` on the console's dev server, signed in as the seeded admin, 1440×900, headless Chromium. The reviewer was a context-free subagent. Its inputs were #27626's Acceptance, the v4 boards at `a7825499aa`, the "What to look at" list in 6514292410, and the console URL. Evidence (never-merged branch `claude/issue-27626-proxy-evidence`, commit `4c9afa65`): [README](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/README.md).

## Verdict per point ("What to re-measure", 6514292410)

1. **Open from the list, cold then warm: 0 list requests. PASS.** No `top=50` and no `top=0` on any open. Contact: cold 11 requests, warm 7, reopen 4. Account: cold 20, warm 10, reopen 4. Evidence: [06](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/06-crm_contact-requests.json) [18](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/18-crm_account-requests.json); shots [02](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/02-crm_contact-drawer-cold.png) [04](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/04-crm_contact-drawer-warm.png) [14](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/14-crm_account-drawer-cold.png) [16](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/16-crm_account-drawer-warm.png).
2. **Close: 0 requests. PASS.** 0 requests in each 10 s window after Escape, over 10 closes across four runs. Shots [03](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/03-crm_contact-list-after-close.png) [15](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/15-crm_account-list-after-close.png).
3. **`field-access`: one per open. PASS.** Exactly one on every open: cold, warm and reopen, on both objects ([06](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/06-crm_contact-requests.json), [18](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/18-crm_account-requests.json)).
4. **`security/explain`: two, and they stay two. PASS.** The first open of a record posts `update` and `delete`, and a reopen of the same record posts none ([06](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/06-crm_contact-requests.json), [18](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/18-crm_account-requests.json), [22](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/22-crossobj-requests.json)).
5. **Child `meta/object/<name>`: cold open only. PASS.** Contact cold reads `crm_activity`. Account cold reads `crm_activity`, `crm_contact`, `crm_lead` and `crm_opportunity`. Warm opens and reopens read none. Across objects in one session, only the names not yet read are fetched ([22](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/22-crossobj-requests.json)).
6. **The bell: 60 s while idle, and it stops in a hidden tab. REWORK on the hidden-tab part.**
   - The 60 s cadence holds: on the idle list, visible, both feeds poll at 12.4 s, 72.3 s and 132.4 s ([12](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/12-bell-polling.json), shot [11](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/11-bell-list-idle-visible.png)).
   - The page was really hidden, as a background tab and as a minimised window, with `visibilityState` reading `hidden` throughout. Both feeds kept polling every 60 s ([12](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/12-bell-polling.json), [19](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/19-bell-hidden-tab.json), [20](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/20-bell-hidden-minimize.json)). They refresh at once when the page is shown again.

## Seat follow-up on point 6

A longer hidden run ([29](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/29-bell-hidden-12min-tab.json), hidden 12.7 minutes as a background tab) shows the rule that is actually in force. Both feeds poll every 60 s for the first 10 minutes of a continuous hide: 9 reads each, the last 544 s into the hide. After that they stop. They read once when the page is shown again. This is the hidden-tab rule from before this PR (objectui#12439: `HIDDEN_POLL_MS` 60 s, stopping after `HIDDEN_POLL_STOP_MS` 10 min), and #27907 did not change it. What changed is the foreground cadence, from 10 s to 60 s. So a hidden tab is now no slower than a visible one for its first 10 minutes.

#27626's Target 4 says the fallback "pauses in hidden tabs". That holds only after 10 minutes. The request comment and this PR's changeset said "still stops in a hidden tab", which was imprecise. The finding stands as a gap against the card's wording, not a regression from this PR. Per the ruling's remedy, it is a new card, not a revert.

## Deviations (6514292410)

- **No push channel exists: CONFIRMED.** Discovery reports `capabilities.websockets.enabled: false` and `services.realtime.enabled: false` ([00](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/00-discovery-38617.json)). The only WebSocket is the Vite hot-reload socket. The bell polls at 60 s. Whether the push seam is pinned by tests cannot be judged from a live console.
- **Measured on `examples/app-crm`, not HotCRM: CONFIRMED.** No HotCRM app is served. The live counts equal the PR body's "after" column exactly (contact 11 / 7 / 0, account 20 / 10 / 0).
- **The cold-open drawer's related lists come from the app scope until the registry lands: CONFIRMED.** Each session reads the full registry once (86 objects; the scope has 6). Every object that points at `crm_account` or `crm_contact` is in the package. The Related tab draws correctly, cold and warm ([25](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/25-crm_account-cold-related-tab.png), [26](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/26-crm_account-warm-related-tab.png)).

## Other findings (non-blocking for this card)

- **List page load sends four pairs of identical GETs at the same moment:** `auth/get-session`, `meta/app`, `auth/me/permissions` and `me/apps`, each ×2 within a few ms ([06](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/06-crm_contact-requests.json) and [18](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/18-crm_account-requests.json), phase `list-load`). This is outside the record-open path the card measured, but it touches Acceptance 1's "the same URL in flight is fetched once".
- **The first cold open's `GET approvals/records/<obj>/<id>/lock` answers 501** and logs a console error. It is not asked again in the session.
- **The live drawer (864 px, modal mask, Details / Related / Timeline tabs) differs from the v4 drawer boards** ([23](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/23-board-drawer-v4-peek.png), [24](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/24-board-drawer-v4-max.png) against [02](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/4c9afa657aded6063452efaae4cb4a1f394b4140/evidence/27626-proxy/02-crm_contact-drawer-cold.png)). The layout belongs to the record-page cards, not this one, and was not judged.
